# Vendored libraries

They're copied here so the app works offline and needs no npm install.

| Library | Version | Files | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CodeMirror 5](https://codemirror.net/5/) | 5.65.16 | `codemirror/codemirror.{js,css}`, modes `python`, `javascript`, `sql`, `clike`, `matchbrackets`, `closebrackets`; `codemirror/addon/`: search, searchcursor, dialog, jump-to-line, match-highlighter, show-hint, active-line, fold (code, gutter, brace, indent, comment), comment, keymaps `sublime` and `vim` | MIT |
| [AlaSQL](https://github.com/AlaSQL/alasql) | 4.6.5 | `alasql/alasql.min.js` (runs the Flipkart SQL question in the browser) | MIT |

## Fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

- `fonts/jetbrains-mono.woff2`: JetBrains Mono, variable weight, Latin subset (from @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0). License: `fonts/OFL-jetbrains-mono.txt`.
- `fonts/inter.woff2`: Inter, variable weight, Latin subset (from @fontsource-variable/inter 5.3.0). License: `fonts/OFL-inter.txt`.
